path.description: Local filesystem path. Relative paths resolve against the caller working directory; convert to pathlib.Path before Python invocation.

identifier.description: Non-empty identifier with no surrounding whitespace.

counts.description: UTF-8 CSV: gene_id then unique sample columns. Raw, finite, non-negative integer counts <= 2147483647; no missing values. No TPM/FPKM. Samples must have positive library sizes.

metadata.description: UTF-8 CSV with unique sample_id and the specified group column. Sample set must exactly match the expression matrix. Missing values, including extra metadata cells, are rejected.

deg.description: Existing full DEG CSV with gene_id, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj (extra columns allowed). Unique gene IDs; NA statistics permitted, infinities forbidden. Never use raw counts as DEG results.

gene_list.description: Non-empty gene IDs: one per line or CSV/TSV with gene_id header. An input DEG CSV contributes ALL its IDs, not automatic significance filtering: supply deg_filtered.csv or an explicitly selected list.

universe.description: Explicit eligible background gene list; includes every query gene. Exactly one non-null universe or analysis_genes is required.

analysis_genes.description: Eligible analysis gene list or FULL DEG CSV (rows with NA padj/log2FC excluded). Intersected with supplied annotation. Not the entire annotation database. Exactly one non-null universe or analysis_genes.

timeout.description: Seconds per external R process. Finite; Heatmap may run two processes.

rscript.description: Trusted executable name/path configured by the host. Not an arbitrary command. A future LLM adapter should not expose this host setting as user-controlled tool input.

output_dir.description: New or empty writable output directory; existing results are never overwritten.

mapping_sheet.description: Required to disambiguate an XLSX workbook with multiple sheets; null for text input or a single sheet.
